rows.reply: The complimentary checked baggage allowance is 23 kg per passenger for all domestic flights. Each checked bag’s dimensions (length + width + height) must not exceed 158 cm (62 inches). For safety, any individual piece weighing more than 32 kg cannot be accepted as checked baggage and must be transported as cargo. Would you like information on excess baggage charges or pre-booking additional weight?

The maximum weight for your single piece of cabin baggage is 7 kg. Passengers may also carry one small personal item that fits under the seat. Any cabin baggage exceeding the 7 kg limit must be checked in at the airport counter. 

Would you like assistance with arranging checked baggage if your cabin bag is over the limit?

Excess checked baggage is charged at a flat rate of Rs 500 per kg. This applies when your checked baggage exceeds the complimentary allowance of 23 kg per passenger. Charges must be paid in full at the airport check-in counter before a boarding pass can be issued. You may pre-book additional baggage weight online through the ACME Bharat Airlines website or mobile app up to 2 hours before departure to access discounted rates.  

Would you like help pre-booking extra baggage online?

Sorry you’re dealing with this. Please report the delayed baggage and file a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) at the airport baggage service desk within 4 hours of arrival. ACME Bharat Airlines provides interim compensation of Rs 1,000 per day for up to a maximum of 5 days, or until the baggage is delivered, whichever is earlier. If the baggage remains untraced after 21 days from the date of flight arrival it will be formally classified as lost; passengers are eligible to claim compensation up to Rs 20,000 for lost baggage. To initiate a lost-baggage claim you must submit the PIR, the original baggage tag, and an itemized list of the contents with supporting receipts. 

Did you file a PIR at the airport baggage service desk yet?

A bag is considered lost if it remains untraced after 21 days from the date of flight arrival. Passengers are eligible to claim compensation up to Rs 20,000 for lost baggage. To initiate a claim you must submit the PIR, the original baggage tag, and an itemized list of the contents with supporting receipts. 

Would you like help with filing the claim?

Sorry to hear your suitcase was damaged. You must file a damage report at the airport baggage service desk within 7 days of your arrival. The claim must include the original baggage tag and clear photos of the damage. Please note ACME Bharat Airlines is not liable for minor wear and tear, scratches, scuffs, or damage from over-packing or inherent defects. Would you like help locating the airport baggage service desk or preparing the photos and documents?

No — any individual piece of baggage weighing more than 32 kg cannot be accepted as checked baggage and must be transported as cargo, so a 35 kg bag cannot be checked in. Would you like help with arranging cargo transport?

For a 3-hour delay (which falls in the 2-4 hours tier) you are entitled to a complimentary meal voucher worth Rs 400, redeemable at designated food and beverage outlets within the departure airport terminal. You can file a claim at the airport service desk or online through the ACME Bharat Airlines claims portal; approved payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval. Would you like help with filing the claim online or finding the airport service desk?

Sorry to hear your flight is delayed. For a delay of 4-6 hours you can choose one of the following options:
- A Rs 3,000 travel voucher valid for future travel with ACME Bharat Airlines, OR
- Free rebooking onto the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight to the same destination, subject to seat availability, with all modification fees waived.

If the delay is caused by weather or air traffic control, there is no compensation under this policy. If you choose a compensation option that requires processing, approved payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval. Would you like me to help you with rebooking or filing a claim?

I’m sorry you’re facing this delay. For a delay of over 6 hours you are entitled to choose one of the following options: a full refund of the ticket price for the affected flight sector, OR free rebooking onto an alternative ACME Bharat Airlines flight, plus a Rs 5,000 travel voucher valid for future travel. You can file a claim at the airport service desk or online through the official ACME Bharat Airlines claims portal; all approved compensation payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval. Note that there is no compensation for delays caused by weather or air traffic control. Would you like to request a refund or rebooking?

Yes. In the event of an overnight delay, where the rescheduled departure time requires an unscheduled overnight stay, complimentary hotel accommodation will be provided by the airline. ACME Bharat Airlines will also arrange and cover the cost of ground transportation between the airport and the hotel. Would you like help filing a claim or finding the airport service desk?

No — under this policy “there is no compensation for delays caused by weather or air traffic control,” and passengers affected by these factors “will not be eligible for travel vouchers, monetary refunds, or meal coupons under this policy.” If you need further assistance, would you like me to help contact AcmeConnect?

All approved compensation payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval. Refunds will be credited back to the original mode of payment used during ticket purchase. 

Would you like instructions on how to file a claim online or at the airport service desk?

You can file a compensation claim at the airport service desk or online through the official ACME Bharat Airlines claims portal. All approved compensation payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval, and refund amounts will be credited back to the original mode of payment used during ticket purchase. Would you like help with filing the claim at the airport or online?

Yes. Any cancellation made within 24 hours of booking qualifies for a full refund of the entire ticket price. This applies regardless of the fare type purchased, and no cancellation fees or penalties will be levied for transactions cancelled within this 24-hour window. Would you like help initiating the cancellation?

Refunds for fully-flexible fares are processed and returned to the original form of payment within 5 business days from the date the cancellation request is submitted. Would you like help initiating the cancellation request?

If you cancel a non-refundable ticket outside the initial 24-hour window: the base fare and carrier-imposed charges are non-reimbursable; government-mandated taxes and airport fees included in the ticket price will be refunded; the remaining eligible portion of the fare will be returned as a travel credit voucher valid for 12 months from the date of issue. To request the refund or voucher, please visit the "Manage Booking" section on the ACME Bharat Airlines website or contact our customer support center. Would you like help locating the "Manage Booking" page?

Sorry to hear your flight was cancelled. Under our policy you can choose either:
- A full refund of the unused ticket value returned to the original form of payment.
- Free rebooking on the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight to the scheduled destination, with any fare differences and change fees waived.

If the cancellation was due to adverse weather or other force majeure, note that we do not provide monetary compensation such as hotel accommodation or meals, but you are still eligible for either free rebooking or a full refund.

To request a refund or rebooking, please visit the "Manage Booking" section on the ACME Bharat Airlines website or contact our customer support center. If you purchased your ticket through a third-party travel agency, you must contact the travel agent to initiate the refund.

Would you like me to guide you to the Manage Booking page or connect you with customer support?

I'm sorry your flight was cancelled due to the storm. For cancellations caused by adverse weather or events beyond our control, ACME Bharat Airlines will provide no monetary compensation (such as hotel accommodation or meals). You are eligible for either free rebooking on the next available flight or a full refund of your ticket value. Would you like me to arrange a rebooking or initiate a full refund?

To request a refund, please visit the "Manage Booking" section on the ACME Bharat Airlines website or contact our customer support center. If your ticket was purchased through a third-party travel agency, you must contact your travel agent directly to initiate the refund process.

If you have a fully-flexible fare, the refund will be processed and returned to the original form of payment within 5 business days from the date the cancellation request is submitted. For non-refundable fares, government-mandated taxes and airport fees will be refunded, and any remaining eligible fare will be returned as a travel credit voucher valid for 12 months from the date of issue.

Was your ticket booked directly with ACME Bharat Airlines or through a travel agent?

For tickets purchased through third-party travel agencies, you must contact your travel agent directly to initiate the refund process — the policy states passengers "must contact their travel agent directly to initiate the refund process." For reference, the policy also notes that "Any cancellation made within 24 hours of booking qualifies for a full refund of the entire ticket price," but that 24-hour provision applies to tickets purchased directly through ACME Bharat Airlines' official channels. Would you like help drafting what to ask your travel agent?

Members earn 5 AcmeMiles per Rs 100 spent on the base fare of an eligible ticket. The base fare calculation excludes government-imposed taxes, airport development fees, passenger service charges, fuel surcharges, and GST. Miles are automatically credited within 48 hours of flight completion if your membership number was entered at booking. Would you like me to check if your recent booking had your membership number entered?
You need 50,000 qualifying miles within a single calendar year (January 1 to December 31) to attain Gold tier. Would you like help checking how many qualifying miles you’ve earned so far?

Yes. All accumulated miles expire after 24 months of account inactivity. Account inactivity means any continuous 24-month period during which you do not record any qualifying transaction, such as earning miles through a flight or redeeming miles for an eligible reward. Expired miles are permanently forfeited and cannot be reinstated, transferred, or exchanged for monetary compensation. Would you like help checking whether your account has any activity within the past 24 months?

Sorry to hear your miles are missing. Miles are normally credited automatically within 48 hours of flight completion if your membership number was entered at booking. To claim missing miles, you must initiate a retroactive claim within 90 days of the date of travel and submit a formal claim request with a copy of your physical or digital boarding pass and the ticket receipt. Claims submitted without a valid boarding pass, or those initiated after the 90-day window has elapsed, will be rejected.  

Can you tell me the date of travel so I can confirm you’re within the 90-day window?

Miles are automatically credited to the member's profile within 48 hours of flight completion, provided the membership number was entered at the time of booking. Would you like me to check whether your miles have been posted for a specific flight?

With 100,000 miles in a single calendar year (January 1 to December 31), you attain Platinum Tier. Once achieved, that status remains valid for the remainder of the current calendar year plus the entirety of the subsequent calendar year. Would you like help checking your current tier status?

Yes. Wheelchair assistance is provided entirely free of charge to all passengers who require mobility support. Passengers must request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before their scheduled flight departure. Would you like me to help with requesting wheelchair assistance for a specific flight?
You must request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before your scheduled flight departure. Would you like help specifying whether you need assistance at departure, arrival, or both?

Yes. The unaccompanied minor service is mandatory for children aged between 5 and 12 years who are traveling alone. The service fee is Rs 3,000 per unaccompanied minor per flight sector. A parent or guardian must accompany the child to the departure check-in counter, complete the required indemnity forms, and remain at the airport until the flight has departed; at the destination, the child will only be released to the authorized guardian specified in the booking documents. Would you like help with anything else for this booking?

Because you are at 30 weeks (which is at or beyond 28 weeks), a valid "Fit-to-Fly" certificate is mandatory. The certificate must be issued by a registered medical practitioner or obstetrician within 7 days of the scheduled departure date and must clearly state the estimated date of delivery, confirm that the pregnancy is uncomplicated, and certify that you are fit to travel by air. Would you like help with what to ask your doctor to include on the certificate?

Your CPAP machine is listed under permitted devices and, if approved, "is carried free of charge and does not count toward the passenger's standard checked or cabin baggage allowance." Please inform the airline at least 48 hours before departure if the device requires battery power. 

Would you like help with initiating the 48-hour notification?

The fit-to-fly certificate must be issued by a registered medical practitioner or obstetrician within 7 days of the scheduled departure date. It must state the estimated date of delivery, confirm the pregnancy is uncomplicated, and certify that the passenger is fit to travel by air. 

Do you need help arranging or confirming this certificate?

Checked baggage: har passenger ko complimentary 23 kg checked baggage allowance milta hai; ek bag ki 3 dimensions (length+width+height) ka sum 158 cm (62 inches) se zyada nahi hona chahiye. Koi bhi individual piece 32 kg se zyada ho to woh checked baggage ke roop mein accept nahi kiya jayega aur cargo ke roop mein bhejna hoga.

Cabin baggage: har passenger ko exactly ek piece cabin baggage le jaane ki ijazat hai, jiska maximum weight 7 kg hai. Saath hi ek chhota personal item (jaise laptop bag, small handbag, infant food bag) ho sakta hai jo seat ke neeche fit ho.

Koi aur sawal?

Maaf kijiye ke aapko deri ka samna karna pad raha hai. 

Agar flight 5 ghante late hai (yani 4-6 hours delay), aapko neeche mein se ek option chunne ka adhikar hai:
- Rs 3,000 travel voucher valid for future travel with ACME Bharat Airlines, OR
- Free rebooking onto the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight to the same destination, subject to seat availability, with all modification fees waived.

Kya aap voucher lena chahenge ya free rebooking karwana pasand karenge?

AcmeMiles mein saare accumulated miles 24 months ki account inactivity ke baad expire ho jaate hain. Account inactivity ka matlab hai koi continuous 24-month period jisme member koi qualifying transaction (jaise flight se miles kamana ya miles redeem karna) nahin karta. Expired miles permanently forfeited ho jaate hain aur unko reinstate, transfer, ya monetary compensation ke liye use nahi kiya ja sakta. Kya main aapki account ki last activity date check karne mein madad karoon?

Haan. ACME Bharat Airlines mein 5 se 12 saal ke bachche agar akele travel kar rahe hain to Unaccompanied Minor service zaroori hai. Service fee Rs 3,000 per unaccompanied minor per flight sector lagti hai. Parent/guardian ko departure check-in counter tak bachche ke saath aana hoga, indemnity forms bharne honge, aur flight departure tak airport par rukna hoga. Destination par bachche ko sirf booking mein diye gaye authorized guardian ko hi handover kiya jayega. 

Kya aap batayenge bachche ki umar aur flight ki tareekh?
